news_drivers.headline: What Moved Markets
news_drivers.summary: Markets rallied on Iran nuclear deal optimism reducing geopolitical tensions, with Trump confirming productive talks and potential uranium cooperation. AMD earnings sparked broad AI hardware rally while European markets surged 2% on deal hopes. Sector rotation favored energy on reduced Middle East risk premium.

items.text: Iran deal progress sparked energy sector rally and reduced geopolitical risk premium
AMD results ignited AI hardware momentum with semiconductors and storage names surging
Boeing and Honeywell rallied on aerospace/defense themes amid ongoing Middle East tensions
European STOXX 600 up 2% reflecting global optimism on Iran diplomatic breakthrough
Shipping disruptions in Strait of Hormuz initially pressured trade-sensitive sectors before deal news
